description: 한국철도기술연구원_지식재산권 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도기술연구원. 한국철도기술연구원이 보유하고 있는 지식재산권에 대한 메타정보를 제공하는 데이터입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국철도기술연구원. Its tags are 고속철도, 특허, 철도, 철도차량, 궤도노반. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-03-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
